QUOTE: neither double call is retry logic. Both are the llama.cpp two-phase sizing idiom: call once with no buffer to learn the required size, then call again with a buffer of that size. Failure is not retried, and a failed tokenization returns an empty result that the callers mostly don't check.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly concludes that the double calls are size negotiation (probe size, then fill) rather than retry, and notes there is no retry after failure and no loop.
